title: Fruit & vegetables

questions.question: How often do you eat fruit and vegetables?
questions.sampleAnswer: I’d say I eat them almost every day, usually some fruit for breakfast and vegetables with my main meals. I try to have a good mix, because they keep me healthy.

questions.question: Where do you usually buy fruit and vegetables?
questions.sampleAnswer: I usually buy them at a local market near my home, because the produce is fresh and cheaper. Sometimes I also order them online when I’m too busy to go out.

questions.question: What kind of fruits and vegetables do you dislike?
questions.sampleAnswer: To be honest, I’m not really into bitter things like bitter melon. I find the taste too strong for me, though I know it’s healthy, so I try to have a little now and then.

questions.question: Were there any kinds you disliked as a child?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I remember I really disliked mushrooms as a child. It was because of the slippery texture, and I used to pick them out of every dish. I’ve grown to like them now, though.

questions.question: Do people in your country like planting vegetables?
questions.sampleAnswer: Generally speaking, yes, it’s becoming quite popular, especially among older people and in small towns. Many families grow vegetables on balconies or in gardens, because it’s fresh and satisfying. I think it’s a good habit that is spreading.
